The 7 `prefab` commands of the editor at engine `319075e3f92b`: each with its description, its kind, the MCP toolsets that offer it, its parameters and their JSON Schema (the other groups have files of their own).

## prefab.apply

Writes a prefab instance (the instance the entity belongs to: its root's subtree, also entities added to it) back into its prefab, keeping the prefab's own root transform and name; with component (and property), only that override of the entity (prefab.status lists them). Every other instance takes the new values except where it overrides them; entities added to the instance are linked. One undo step for the file and the scene (edit.undo restores both). Edit mode only; imported models cannot be changed (prefab.unpack them, or prefab.create a prefab). An outdated instance (prefab.status: made from an older version, it missed the prefab's later changes) is refused unless force: true, since it would write its older values over them. Returns {prefab, path, root, updatedInstances, linked}.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorPrefabCommands.cpp:436`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | string | no |   | Apply only this component of the entity (added, removed or changed). |
| `entity` | string | yes |   | An entity of the instance (its root or below); with component, the entity whose override is applied (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `force` | boolean | no |   | Apply an outdated instance anyway, writing its values over the prefab's later changes (default false). |
| `property` | string | no |   | With component: apply only this property (scripts: &lt;Class&gt; or &lt;Class&gt;.&lt;Field&gt;). |

## prefab.create

Saves entities and their descendants as a new prefab asset (.stprefab). With link (the default) they become an instance of it, linked as prefab.instantiate's instances are (prefab.apply, prefab.revert, prefab.status); one undo step for the file and the link (edit.undo moves the file to the trash and unlinks them). Links of another prefab they had are replaced. Returns {asset, path, linked}.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorAssetCommands.cpp:1213`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entities` | array of string | yes |   | Root entities of the prefab (entity IDs). Items: at least 1. |
| `link` | boolean | no |   | Make the entities an instance of the new prefab (default true; not while playing; refused while a scene is being opened). |
| `path` | string | yes |   | Path relative to the asset directory. |

## prefab.instantiate

Instantiates a prefab or imported model, optionally under a parent and with component values on its root (undoable; while playing it changes the running copy only). An instance whose name a sibling has gets a number ('Crate' -&gt; 'Crate (1)'). Returns {id (the first root), entities (every root)}; the instance stays linked to the prefab (prefab.status, prefab.apply, prefab.revert). With instances: \[{parent?, components?}\] (instead of parent and components) it makes many in one undo step, at most 100,000, and returns {instances: \[{id, entities}\]} in their order; instances that give only a Transform are made together, the fastest way.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorPrefabCommands.cpp:341`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `components` | object | no |   | Component values applied to the instance's root, e.g. {&quot;Transform&quot;: {&quot;Translation&quot;: \[2, 0, 0\]}}. |
| `instances` | array of object | no |   | Many instances in one step: \[{parent?, components?}\], each like the parameters of one. Items: at least 1, at most 100000. |
| `parent` | string or null | no |   | Parent; null or omitted for the top level (entity ID or null). |
| `prefab` | string | yes |   | Prefab or model (asset handle, or path relative to the asset directory). |

## prefab.revert

Gives a prefab instance (the instance the entity belongs to) its prefab's values again: entities keep their IDs (matched by the prefab's entity ids), entities the prefab lacks go, entities the instance lacks are made, and the root keeps its parent, place, transform and name. With component (and property), only that component (or property) of the entity reverts: a component the prefab lacks goes, one the entity lacks comes back. One undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only). Returns {root, prefab, created}.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorPrefabCommands.cpp:585`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | string | no |   | Revert only this component of the entity. |
| `entity` | string | yes |   | An entity of the instance (its root or below); with component, the entity whose override is reverted (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `property` | string | no |   | With component: revert only this property (scripts: &lt;Class&gt; or &lt;Class&gt;.&lt;Field&gt;). |

## prefab.select

Selects the root of the prefab instance the entity belongs to, or with asset: true shows its prefab in the asset inspector (the Content Browser reveals it). Returns {root, prefab}.

## prefab.status

Whether an entity belongs to a prefab instance and how the instance differs from its prefab as stored now (the root's transform and name are the instance's own and never count): {linked, root, prefab, path, modified, outdated, changed: \[entity ids whose values differ\], added: \[entities the prefab lacks\], removed: \[ids of prefab entities the instance lacks\], overrides: \[{entity (the scene's; null for an entity the instance removed), prefabEntity, component, property (script fields: &lt;Class&gt;.&lt;Field&gt;), kind: Property \| AddedComponent \| RemovedComponent \| RemovedEntity}\]}; {linked: false} for entities of no instance. Prefab changes reach every instance except where it overrides them. outdated: the instance was made from an older version of the prefab and did not take its later changes (it was modified meanwhile), so prefab.apply would write its older values back.

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorPrefabCommands.cpp:395`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | string | yes |   | An entity of the active scene (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |

{
  "additionalProperties": false,

## prefab.unpack

Ends the link between a prefab instance (the instance the entity belongs to) and its prefab: its entities stay as they are, as plain entities. One undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only). Returns {root, entities (how many were unlinked)}.
